description: This file contains C source code implementing vendor-specific extensions and utilities for WLAN access points, including functions for creating, destroying, and managing virtual access points (VAPs), obtaining station statistics, handling SSIDs, and interacting with vendor and hardware layers.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_vendorCb_bssid(T_Radio * pRad,T_AccessPoint * pAP,unsigned char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Sets the BSSID for a given access point or radio, formatting the MAC address into the buffer.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_vendorCb_addVapIf(T_Radio * rad _UNUSED,char * vap _UNUSED,int bufsize _UNUSED)
methods.description: Adds a virtual access point interface, generating and setting its BSSID if applicable.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_th_vap_createHook(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Initializes vendor-specific data for an access point during creation.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_destroyHook(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Cleans up vendor-specific data when an access point is destroyed.

methods.name: T_AccessPoint * wld_th_vap_createVap(amxb_bus_ctx_t * const bus_ctx,wld_th_mockVendor_t * mockVendor _UNUSED,T_Radio * radio,const char * name)
methods.description: Creates a new virtual access point by calling the WiFi addVAPIntf method and retrieving the created AP.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_status(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Returns whether the access point has its stack enabled.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_th_vap_getStationStats(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Retrieves station statistics, either from file or by updating device states, and processes associated devices accordingly.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_setSSIDEnable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Sets the SSID enable state, optionally committing immediately.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_setApEnable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,bool enable,bool commit)
methods.description: Sets the access point enable state, optionally committing immediately.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_enable(T_AccessPoint * pAP,int enable,int set)
methods.description: Enables or disables a VAP, updating FSM actions accordingly.

methods.name: int wld_th_vap_ssid(T_AccessPoint * pAP,char * buf,int bufsize,int set)
methods.description: Gets or sets the SSID of an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_doFsmClean(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Clears FSM action bits for the access point.

methods.name: wld_th_vap_vendorData_t * wld_th_vap_getVendorData(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Retrieves vendor-specific data structure from an access point.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_checkCommitAll(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Checks that all FSM actions have been committed when expected.

methods.name: void wld_th_vap_checkCommitted(T_AccessPoint * pAP,swl_mask_m commitMask)
methods.description: Verifies that specific FSM actions have been committed based on a mask.
